item.media:description: Sam Darnold is coming off a second straight Pro Bowl season, one in which he led the Seahawks to their second Super Bowl title.

item.title: Ravens' Nnamdi Madubuike prepared to return after year-plus absence
item.description: While Madubuike returns, the Ravens will be without left tackle Ronnie Stanley and receiver Zay Flowers remains "questionable."
item.media:description: Nnamdi Madubuike hasn't played since Week 2 last season, and getting him back — even on a limited basis — is a big positive for the Ravens.

item.title: Rams' Puka Nacua doubtful for game vs. Broncos, per coach Sean McVay
item.description: The Rams are not considering injured reserve as an option for Nacua, who also missed last week's game against the New York Giants.
item.media:description: "I think doubtful means it's more unlikely than likely he'll play," coach Sean McVay said Friday.

item.title: Raiders tight end Brock Bowers is questionable to play vs. Saints
item.description: Las Vegas has gotten off to an improbable 2-0 start without its best offensive player.
item.media:description: The Raiders are 2-0 without having any contributions from star tight end Brock Bowers.

item.title: NFLPA executive director JC Tretter says issues with fields in Brazil 'not a coincidence'
item.description: Tretter also said that growing the game internationally can't come at the expense of "maintaining the standards our players deserve."
item.media:description: The field inside Maracana Stadium where the Cowboys and Ravens play Sunday has been subject to a lot of discussion this week.

item.title: Four big questions for NFL Week 3, including an 0-3 risk for Colts, Texans
item.description: Are the Vikings better with Kyler Murray? Can the Texans or Colts survive a loss? Are the Raiders legit?
